title: Lab: rewrite 3 weak prompts into strong ones
body:
🛠 Lab exercise

Rewrite each weak prompt below into a strong, specific version using everything from this module (task, context, constraints, format, persona as needed):

  1. Weak: "Tell me about leadership."
  2. Weak: "Fix this code." (imagine you have code with a bug)
  3. Weak: "Write an email."

For each rewrite, identify which elements you added (task, context, constraint, format, persona) and why. Run the improved version in an AI assistant and note whether the output quality improved.
